title: Getting UK tax data with hmrc
text: get_tax_receipts() downloads monthly HMRC Tax Receipts National Insurance Contributions bulletin, covering 41 tax heads April 2016 recent published month. Use list_tax_heads() see available identifiers without downloading data: Filter specific heads date ranges:
code: # All 41 tax heads receipts <- get_tax_receipts() head(receipts) #>         date   tax_head          description receipts_gbp_m #>   2016-04-01 income_tax Income Tax (PAYE...          17423 #>   2016-05-01 income_tax Income Tax (PAYE...          11847 list_tax_heads() big_three <- get_tax_receipts(   tax   = c("income_tax", "vat", "nics_total"),   start = "2020-01" ) library(ggplot2)  ggplot(big_three, aes(x = date, y = receipts_gbp_m / 1000, colour = description)) +   geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +   scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma(suffix = "bn")) +   labs(     title   = "UK monthly tax receipts",     x       = NULL,     y       = "GBP billions",     colour  = NULL,     caption = "Source: HMRC Tax Receipts and NICs bulletin"   ) +   theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +   theme(legend.position = "bottom")

title: Getting UK tax data with hmrc
text: get_vat() covers monthly VAT receipts April 1973, broken payments, repayments, import VAT, home VAT.
code: # Net VAT: total minus repayments vat <- get_vat(measure = c("total", "repayments"), start = "2015-01")  # Repayments are recorded as negative (money flowing out of HMRC) head(vat[vat$measure == "repayments", c("date", "receipts_gbp_m")])

title: Getting UK tax data with hmrc
text: get_fuel_duties() covers monthly hydrocarbon oil duty receipts January 1990, broken petrol, diesel, , total.
code: fuel <- get_fuel_duties(fuel = "total", start = "2010-01")  # Annual totals fuel$year <- format(fuel$date, "%Y") aggregate(receipts_gbp_m ~ year, data = fuel, FUN = sum)

title: Getting UK tax data with hmrc
text: get_tobacco_duties() covers monthly tobacco duty receipts January 1991, product: cigarettes, cigars, hand-rolling tobacco, , total.
code: tobacco <- get_tobacco_duties(product = c("cigarettes", "hand_rolling"),                               start   = "2015-01")

title: Getting UK tax data with hmrc
text: get_corporation_tax() returns annual Corporation Tax receipts broken levy type — onshore CT, offshore CT, Bank Levy, Bank Surcharge, Residential Property Developer Tax (RPDT), Energy Profits Levy (EPL), Electricity Generators Levy (EGL). Covers 2019-20 recent financial year.
code: ct <- get_corporation_tax() ct[ct$type == "total_ct", c("tax_year", "receipts_gbp_m")]

title: Getting UK tax data with hmrc
text: get_stamp_duty() returns annual stamp duty receipts type 2003-04: SDLT property, SDLT new leases, SDRT shares, stamp duty documents.
code: sd <- get_stamp_duty(type = "sdlt_total") tail(sd[, c("tax_year", "receipts_gbp_m")], 5)

title: Getting UK tax data with hmrc
text: get_rd_credits() returns annual statistics R&D tax credit claims cost scheme (SME R&D Relief RDEC) 2000-01.

text: get_tax_gap() returns recent cross-sectional tax gap estimates, broken tax type, taxpayer group, behaviour component (evasion, error, avoidance, etc.).
code: gap <- get_tax_gap()  # Sort by absolute gap gap[order(-gap$gap_gbp_bn),     c("tax", "component", "gap_gbp_bn", "uncertainty")]

title: Download and Tidy HMRC Statistical Data
text: HM Revenue Customs UK government department responsible collecting taxes, paying certain forms state support, enforcing customs rules. single largest gatherer government revenue: 2023-24, HMRC collected around £830bn taxes duties - roughly 90% government receipts. distinction HMRC OBR matters anyone working UK fiscal data. HM Treasury sets fiscal policy: decides tax rates spending plans. OBR forecasts fiscal outcomes independently. HMRC reports actually came - cash receipts plans forecasts measured. want know government intended raise, use OBR. want know actually raised, use HMRC. HMRC publishes monthly receipts data covering every major tax duty - Income Tax, VAT, NICs, Corporation Tax, fuel duties, stamp duties, alcohol tobacco duties, . closely watched economic data published UK government. moves markets, informs fiscal policy debates, widely cited journalism, think-tank analysis, parliamentary briefings.

title: Download and Tidy HMRC Statistical Data
text: HMRC’s statistical data freely available gov.uk. problem available. Every file ODS spreadsheet. Every file’s download URL contains random media hash changes publication cycle - meaning hardcoded URLs stop working every month. API. Getting data R requires knowing right URL pattern, navigating GOV.UK publication pages manually, reading ODS file non-standard headers, pivoting wide-format sheets long format, standardising column names. every month. package automatically. Download URLs resolved runtime via GOV.UK Content API, data always current. One function call returns clean, tidy data frame. Data cached locally subsequent calls instant.
code: # Without this package url  <- # ... navigate gov.uk, find the ODS link with the rotating hash ... path <- tempfile(fileext = ".ods") download.file(url, path) raw  <- readODS::read_ods(path, sheet = "Receipts_Monthly", col_names = FALSE) hdr  <- as.character(unlist(raw[6, ])) data <- raw[7:nrow(raw), ] # ... pivot, parse dates, rename columns, filter ...  # With this package library(hmrc) get_tax_receipts()

title: Download HMRC Income Tax liabilities by income range — get_income_tax_stats
text: Downloads tidies HMRC Table 2.5, reports number Income Tax payers liabilities grouped total income range, available tax year. Numbers taxpayers thousands; amounts millions pounds unless otherwise noted. Published annually May/June.

title: Download HMRC Income Tax liabilities by income range — get_income_tax_stats
code: get_income_tax_stats(tax_year = NULL, cache = TRUE)

title: Download HMRC Income Tax liabilities by income range — get_income_tax_stats
text: https://www.gov.uk/government/statistics/income-tax-liabilities--income-range

title: Download HMRC Income Tax liabilities by income range — get_income_tax_stats
text: tax_year Character vector NULL (default = years). Filter specific tax years, e.g. "2023-24". cache Logical. Use cached file available (default TRUE).

title: Download HMRC Income Tax liabilities by income range — get_income_tax_stats
text: data frame columns: tax_year Character. Tax year, e.g. "2022-23". income_range Character. Income range label. income_lower_gbp Numeric. Lower limit income range pounds. NA "Ranges" row. taxpayers_thousands Numeric. Number Income Tax payers (thousands). total_income_gbp_m Numeric. Total income (millions pounds). tax_liability_gbp_m Numeric. Total Income Tax liability (millions pounds). average_rate_pct Numeric. Average rate Income Tax (percent). average_tax_gbp Numeric. Average amount Income Tax per taxpayer (pounds).

what: Download monthly UK property transaction counts — get_property_transactions
title: Download monthly UK property transaction counts — get_property_transactions
text: Downloads tidies HMRC Monthly Property Transactions bulletin, counts residential non-residential property transactions (SDLT returns, LBTT Scotland, LTT Wales) England, Scotland, Wales, Northern Ireland, UK total. Data runs April 2005 recent completed month.

title: Download monthly UK property transaction counts — get_property_transactions
code: get_property_transactions(   type = c("all", "residential", "non_residential"),   nation = NULL,   start = NULL,   end = NULL,   cache = TRUE )

title: Download monthly UK property transaction counts — get_property_transactions
text: https://www.gov.uk/government/statistics/monthly-property-transactions-completed---uk--value-40000--

title: Download monthly UK property transaction counts — get_property_transactions
text: type Character. One "" (default), "residential", "non_residential". nation Character vector NULL (default = nations). Valid values: "uk", "england", "scotland", "wales", "northern_ireland". start Character "YYYY-MM" Date object. Rows month dropped. end Character "YYYY-MM" Date object. Rows month dropped. cache Logical. TRUE (default), downloaded file cached.

title: Download monthly UK property transaction counts — get_property_transactions
text: data frame columns: date Date. first day reference month. nation Character. One "uk", "england", "scotland", "wales", "northern_ireland". type Character. "residential" "non_residential". transactions Numeric. Number transactions.

title: Download HMRC R&D tax credit statistics — get_rd_credits
text: Downloads tidies HMRC Research Development Tax Credits Statistics publication, covering SME R&D Relief Research Development Expenditure Credit (RDEC) schemes. Annual data runs 2000-01 recent financial year, published annually September.

title: Download HMRC R&D tax credit statistics — get_rd_credits
code: get_rd_credits(scheme = NULL, measure = NULL, cache = TRUE)

title: Download HMRC R&D tax credit statistics — get_rd_credits
text: https://www.gov.uk/government/statistics/corporate-tax-research--development-tax-credit

title: Download HMRC R&D tax credit statistics — get_rd_credits
text: scheme Character vector NULL (default = schemes). Valid values: "sme" (SME R&D Relief), "rdec" (Research Development Expenditure Credit / large company scheme), "total" (combined). measure Character vector NULL (default = measures). Valid values: "claims" (number claims), "amount_gbp_m" (cost millions pounds). cache Logical. Use cached file available (default TRUE).

title: Download HMRC R&D tax credit statistics — get_rd_credits
text: data frame columns: tax_year Character. Financial year, e.g. "2023-24". scheme Character. Scheme identifier. description Character. Plain-English scheme label. measure Character. Either "claims" "amount_gbp_m". value Numeric. Number claims cost millions pounds.

title: Download HMRC R&D tax credit statistics — get_rd_credits
text: Data 2003-04 covers SME scheme (RDEC / large company scheme introduced 2002). Figures recent two years provisional subject revision late claims processed.

title: Download HMRC tax receipts and National Insurance contributions — get_tax_receipts
text: Downloads tidies monthly HMRC Tax Receipts National Insurance Contributions bulletin published GOV.UK. bulletin covers major UK taxes duties April 2016 recent month (monthly granularity), updated approximately 15th working day month.

title: Download HMRC tax receipts and National Insurance contributions — get_tax_receipts
code: get_tax_receipts(tax = NULL, start = NULL, end = NULL, cache = TRUE)

title: Download HMRC tax receipts and National Insurance contributions — get_tax_receipts
text: https://www.gov.uk/government/statistics/hmrc-tax--nics-receipts---uk

title: Download HMRC tax receipts and National Insurance contributions — get_tax_receipts
text: tax Character vector tax head identifiers, NULL (default) return available series. Use list_tax_heads() see valid values descriptions. start Character "YYYY-MM" Date object. provided, rows month dropped. end Character "YYYY-MM" Date object. provided, rows month dropped. cache Logical. TRUE (default), downloaded file cached locally reused subsequent calls. Use clear_cache() reset.

title: Download HMRC tax receipts and National Insurance contributions — get_tax_receipts
text: data frame columns: date Date. first day reference month. tax_head Character. Tax duty identifier (see list_tax_heads()). description Character. Plain-English series label. receipts_gbp_m Numeric. Cash receipts millions pounds (GBP).

title: Download HMRC VAT receipts — get_vat
text: Downloads tidies HMRC VAT Annual Statistics bulletin, reports monthly VAT receipts broken payments, repayments, import VAT, home VAT. Monthly data runs April 1973; bulletin published annually (December).

title: Download HMRC VAT receipts — get_vat
code: get_vat(measure = NULL, start = NULL, end = NULL, cache = TRUE)

title: Download HMRC VAT receipts — get_vat
text: https://www.gov.uk/government/statistics/value-added-tax-vat-annual-statistics

title: Download HMRC VAT receipts — get_vat
text: measure Character vector NULL (default = measures). Valid values: "total", "payments", "repayments", "import_vat", "home_vat". start Character "YYYY-MM" Date object. end Character "YYYY-MM" Date object. cache Logical. Use cached file available (default TRUE).

title: Download HMRC VAT receipts — get_vat
text: data frame columns: date Date. First day reference month. measure Character. VAT measure identifier. description Character. Plain-English measure label. receipts_gbp_m Numeric. Value millions pounds. Repayments negative (money flowing HMRC businesses).

title: Download HMRC VAT receipts — get_vat
text: Note early years (pre-1985) suppressed payment repayment splits; total available periods. January 2021, import VAT collected via postponed VAT accounting recorded within payments repayments rather import VAT column.

what: hmrc: Download and Tidy HMRC Statistical Data — hmrc-package
title: hmrc: Download and Tidy HMRC Statistical Data — hmrc-package
text: Provides functions download, parse, tidy statistical data published HM Revenue Customs (HMRC) GOV.UK. Covers tax receipts, National Insurance contributions, property transactions. File URLs resolved runtime via GOV.UK Content API, data always current.

title: hmrc: Download and Tidy HMRC Statistical Data — hmrc-package
text: get_tax_receipts() — monthly tax receipts NICs (heads, April 2016+) get_property_transactions() — monthly property transaction counts (April 2005+) get_income_tax_stats() — annual Income Tax liabilities income range get_tax_gap() — annual tax gap estimates tax type get_stamp_duty() — annual stamp duty receipts (SDLT, SDRT) get_vat() — monthly VAT receipts breakdown (April 1973+) get_rd_credits() — annual R&D tax credit statistics (2000-01+) get_fuel_duties() — monthly fuel duty receipts (January 1990+) get_tobacco_duties() — monthly tobacco duty receipts (January 1991+) get_corporation_tax() — annual Corporation Tax receipts type list_tax_heads() — lookup table available tax head identifiers clear_cache() — manage locally cached files

title: hmrc: Download and Tidy HMRC Statistical Data — hmrc-package

text: get_corporation_tax() now dynamically detects latest publication year instead using hardcoded slug. prevents function breaking HMRC publishes new annual edition.

title: hmrc 0.3.2
text: CRAN release: 2026-03-17 Removed non-existent pkgdown URL DESCRIPTION.

title: hmrc 0.3.1
text: Examples now cache tempdir() instead user’s home directory, fixing CRAN policy compliance \donttest examples. Cache directory now configurable via options(hmrc.cache_dir = ...).

title: hmrc 0.3.0
text: CRAN release: 2026-03-12 Added get_income_tax_stats(): annual Income Tax liabilities income range, including taxpayer counts, total income, tax liabilities, average tax rates (Table 2.5).

title: hmrc 0.2.0
text: Added get_vat(): monthly VAT receipts component (payments, repayments, import VAT, home VAT) April 1973. Added get_fuel_duties(): monthly hydrocarbon oil duty receipts fuel type (petrol, diesel, ) January 1990. Added get_tobacco_duties(): monthly tobacco duty receipts product (cigarettes, cigars, hand-rolling, ) January 1991. Added get_corporation_tax(): annual Corporation Tax receipts levy type (onshore, offshore, Bank Levy, Bank Surcharge, RPDT, EPL, EGL) 2019-20. Added get_stamp_duty(): annual stamp duty receipts type (SDLT, SDRT, stamp duty documents) 2003-04. Added get_rd_credits(): annual R&D tax credit claims cost scheme (SME R&D Relief RDEC) 2000-01. Added get_tax_gap(): cross-sectional tax gap estimates tax type, taxpayer group, behaviour component recent year. Updated DESCRIPTION reflect full package scope. Updated vignette cover functions.

title: hmrc 0.1.0
text: Initial release. get_tax_receipts(): monthly cash receipts 41 tax heads, April 2016 present. list_tax_heads(): catalogue available tax head identifiers. get_property_transactions(): monthly residential non-residential property transaction counts UK nation, April 2005 present. clear_cache(): delete locally cached HMRC files.
